name: frog_joins
doc: In the Cathedral (loc 081) Crono walks up the nave to the altar and checks the glint below it (Marle's hairpin, obj 15); the nuns turn into Naga-ettes (battle D8 92 80, won by mashing A -- Crono and Lucca end it near 17 HP), Frog bursts in, 'Go with the frog.', his naming screen (the default name Frog, Start) and he joins: $2980 = 00 02 04 01 (Crono, Lucca, Frog; Marle held), storyline 12 -> 15. Crono free before the altar.
